\section{Method}\label{sec:method}
The estimator averages the samples $\vect{x}$, as in Eq.~\eqref{eq:mean}.
\begin{equation}
  \hat{\mu} = \half{x_1 + x_2}
  \label{eq:mean}
\end{equation}
Its variance follows directly:
\[
  \operatorname{Var}\hat{\mu} = \half{\sigma^2}
\]
